newsitem.title: USA: Clinton names Yellen to head women's panel.
newsitem.headline: Clinton names Yellen to head women's panel.

text.p: President Clinton Thursday named Janet Yellen, chair of his Council of Economic Advisers, to serve as the head of the Interagency Committee on Women's Business Enterprise.

Yellen, a former member of the Federal Reserve Board, will oversee officials from various federal agencies and departments charged with developing private efforts to foster businesses operated by women.
